# Stuhl Services LLC

> Owner-operated home remodeling company based in Gillette, New Jersey. Licensed, insured, and bonded (NJ Home Improvement Contractor license 13VH11735700). Serving Morris, Somerset, Union, and Essex Counties.

- Phone: 908-723-5922
- Email: stuhlservices@gmail.com
- Website: https://stuhlservices.com
- Free estimates. Every inquiry gets a callback within 24 hours.

## Services

- Bathroom remodeling: full remodels, walk-in and curb-less showers, custom tile, vanity upgrades
- Basement finishing: family rooms, home offices, guest suites, full bathrooms
- Kitchen remodeling: complete redesigns, IKEA kitchen installs, cabinetry, islands, lighting
- Flooring: tile, luxury vinyl, laminate
- Carpentry: built-ins, trim, shelving, custom storage
- Handyman work: repairs and smaller jobs around the house

## Service area

Long Hill Township (Gillette, Stirling, Millington), Berkeley Heights, New Providence, Summit, Warren, Watchung, Basking Ridge, Bernardsville, Chatham, Madison, Morristown, Mountainside, Millburn (including Short Hills), and Westfield, NJ.
